label: ANTs ExtractRegionFromImage
description:
Extract an axis-aligned image region using start and end indices.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: dimension
parameters.description: Image dimensionality. Match the actual input image.
parameters.usage: Image dimensionality. Match the actual input image. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: start
parameters.usage: x-separated start indices. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: end
parameters.description: x-separated end indices; match image bounds.
parameters.usage: x-separated end indices; match image bounds. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Extract an axis-aligned image region using start and end indices. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
